info.about: Ninja Five-O, known in the PAL region as Ninja Cop, is a 2003 action-platform video game developed by Hudson Soft and published by Konami. It was released for the Game Boy Advance in North America and Europe in April 2003.
info.why: Konami shipped a very small run in 2003 and the game barely reached retail, leaving it one of the scarcest North American Game Boy Advance cartridges.
